column1: # Two selection bases, both recorded so a reader can tell them apart.
# competitor-validated: 5,309,406 only. 26,029,591 is the closed guard.
# truth-selected (no competitor involved): the gap sits in real sequence
#   (truth hets <= 4/kb) and every consecutive truth-het pair across it is
#   covered by >= 3 reads, so a chain exists.
# competitor_acc is hiphase's READ-LEVEL orientation purity over reads in the
# window that carry HP/PS and appear in the parental truth map -- NOT site-level
# agreement, which ran on 2-4 shared sites here and disagreed with the read-level
# answer on two of the six windows. 'none_spanning' means no hiphase block spans
# the gap. Context for a failure message; nothing asserts on it.
# 3,852,321 is the case worth remembering: hiphase spans it in one 875 kb block
# at 63.1% read purity -- a wrong join. Do not treat its span as a target to match.
